This is achieved by paralleling the necessary units to meet the demand, which increases the system's capacity and reliability. The system also enables the summation of powers, allowing the connection of two or more No-Breaks to reach the total load demand. Furthermore, it supports the parallel connection of No-Breaks with different powers, distributing the load proportionally.

In terms of remote management, the system utilizes the SNMP NetMate adapter, which permits the remote management of the No-Break via the internet through a web browser.
